cand.title: Art Genève
cand.excerpt: Event evidence is strong; ranking is reduced where the venue is committed or hotel sourcing is unconfirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Charlotte Diwan, Director, and Audrey Dijkhuizen, Project manager, are named on the official team page. They are relevant organizer-side relationship/routing contacts, not verified hotel buyers or contract signatories. Approach via the published shared channel info@artgeneve.ch, +41 22 761 11 11, asking for the accommodation/partnership lead. No individual email or accommodation purchasing authority is established.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced 15th edition: public fair 28–31 January 2027 at Palexpo, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. These are activity dates, not publication dates, and fall within the requested horizon. No official 2028 edition dates were located as of 17 November 2026. Do not project the historical 2026 VIP-preview date into 2027.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied YOTEL specifications: retain only a conditional satellite lodging role for a defined exhibitor, installation or organizer team willing to commute from Founex. Palexpo’s airport-corridor location is geographically more relevant than a downtown-only venue, but no Art Genève demand toward La Côte or YOTEL is documented. Do not position the 237-room hotel as primary fair housing or an alternative exhibition venue. Any proposed 20–120-room group range is a sales-screening envelope supplied in the brief, not published demand. Meeting rooms could support a separately commissioned small briefing, not the fair itself; catering capacity and transfers need validation. This is not evidenced resort/retreat demand.
findings.venueCommitments: Palexpo is the publicly confirmed 2027 event venue; no hall allocation or signed venue contract was published in the reviewed material. Territory: Geneva Airport corridor, municipality of Le Grand-Saconnex, not downtown Geneva and not Founex/Nyon/La Côte. It is an exhibition centre, not a competing hotel. Palexpo states it is a 10-minute walk from Geneva International Airport. This establishes venue access, not evidence that specific delegates will fly or stay along La Côte.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified timeline: 25–28 January 2024, 30 January–2 February 2025, and 29 January–1 February 2026, all at Palexpo, Geneva/Le Grand-Saconnex; 2027 remains at Palexpo. No destination or venue rotation is evidenced across these editions. The municipal 2024 record describes a late-January Palexpo fair held for more than ten years. Art Monte-Carlo is a separate fair, not an Art Genève destination rotation.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing remains unconfirmed. The current English partner page explicitly references 2027 and includes “Partner hotels”; the named hotel entries are Manotel and President. Manotel is a hotel group, not a named individual property. The page does not allocate a specific Manotel hotel or publish 2027 room allotments, rates, codes, booking deadlines, or a housing bureau. The French page contains legacy “2026” lead-partner wording, so its logos alone cannot prove 2027 room commitments. Historical 2026 official releases thank “Manotel et l’InterContinental”; InterContinental is historical, not verified as a 2027 lodging commitment. Manotel independently describes itself as an ArtGenève partner without an edition-specific room block. No public open hotel RFP or centralized accommodation contract was found; absence of a published scheme does not mean sourcing is open.
findings.organizationStructure: Palexpo’s official listing names Palexpo SA as organizer; Art Genève is the event/programme brand. The fair website identifies PALEXPO SA as publisher, registered in Geneva as CHE-114.342.370. The evidenced structure is a corporate exhibition organizer operating the fair at its namesake venue, not a verified membership association, travel-trade intermediary, PCO or DMC. No external housing agency was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Existing publicly listed partner relationships are Manotel and President; the historical 2026 hotel acknowledgements additionally name InterContinental. These are competitive relationships, not proof of exclusive or centrally contracted lodging. No sourced sell-out, denied requests, overflow allocation, room shortage, peak rooms or room-night figure was found. Historical visitor attendance cannot be converted into hotel demand because overnight share and stay lengths are unknown.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Audrey Dijkhuizen through info@artgeneve.ch, referencing Charlotte Diwan as director. Ask who controls hotel partnerships and whether Manotel/President arrangements are exclusive, centrally booked, or referral-only. Request only any demonstrably uncontracted exhibitor/production-team need for 28–31 January 2027 and separately verified setup/strike nights. If a named group accepts Founex and workable transfers, prepare a capped satellite proposal within the hotel’s supplied 20–120-room guidance; otherwise record relationship-development only and request the next partner-review timing without inventing 2028 dates.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 venue access is confirmed, hotel-sales access is not. Existing hotel partners make a new official housing role uncertain. A conditional enquiry about uncontracted exhibitor/team rooms is appropriate; do not publish available blocks, overflow, preferred status or centrally uncontracted lodging as facts. Advance only if the organizer confirms a permissible non-exclusive route and a named group with dates, room nights and transport needs.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: repeated Palexpo editions support a future relationship-development route rather than destination-bid capture. Ask about the next hotel-partner review and non-exclusive satellite lodging for exhibitor teams. No 2028 dates, RFP, procurement window or open hotel inventory is verified. Keep future competitive capture separate from the confirmed 2027 fair and historical partner acknowledgements.

Historical VIP/press preview was 28 January 2026; not the public opening date and not evidence of a 2027 preview.

Obtain an actual named group, nightly room pattern, budget, setup/strike dates and acceptance of Founex transfers before marking this sales eligible.
Request the next partner-review timing; do not assume annual hotel sourcing or announce a 2028 edition.
remainingUncertainties: No verified 2027 housing bureau, room block, rates, exclusivity terms or purchasing controller; hotel-partner listing is not a booking commitment.

2025 organizer closing release and venue annual report disagree on visitor count and starting date; public dates and attendance above follow the edition-specific organizer release.
